sources.title: ID.4 | Electric SUV (Volkswagen Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. MY26 ID. 4 Pro From $64,990 driveaway with free home EV charger; MY27 ID. 4 Pro From $65,990 Driveaway. Footnotes: manufacturer's recommended campaign driveaway price for new ID. 4 Pro 1-Speed Automatic vehicles in white purchased from 01/10/2026 and delivered by 31/12/2026, private buyers only, excludes other offers, options and metallic paint extra, while stocks last. The page invites a search of stock or contact with a dealer about placing an order.

sources.title: ID.4 GTX | Electric Sport SUV (Volkswagen Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. MY27 ID. 4 GTX From $75,990 driveaway with free home EV charger; manufacturer's recommended campaign driveaway price for new MY27 ID. 4 GTX 1-Speed Automatic vehicles in white purchased from 01/10/2026 and delivered by 31/12/2026, private buyers only, while stocks last.
